# 🛠️ C Systems Programming & Memory Mastery Track

Welcome to the **C Systems Programming & Memory Mastery Track** materialized by **Trak**.

This workspace is an in-depth curriculum covering low-level memory allocation (`malloc`/`free`), pointer arithmetic, data structure alignment, POSIX system calls (`fork`, `exec`), `pthreads`, and defensive systems engineering.

## 📚 Syllabus & Module Map

| Module | Title | Key Topics & Internals |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-toolchain` | Toolchain & Compilation Pipeline | GCC/Clang, Makefiles, Preprocessor (`-E`), Assembler (`-S`), Linker (`-o`) |
| `01-basics-types-and-memory` | Exact-Width Types & Endianness | `<stdint.h>`, `size_t`, `ptrdiff_t`, Big-Endian vs Little-Endian bytes |
| `02-pointers-and-address-arithmetic` | Pointers & Memory Addresses | Dereference (`*`), Address-of (`&`), pointer scaling arithmetic, `void*` |
| `03-memory-allocation-malloc-free` | Dynamic Heap Management | `malloc`, `calloc`, `realloc`, `free`, fragmentation, use-after-free |
| `04-arrays-and-pointer-decay` | Array Decay & Multi-dim Pointers | Array to pointer decay, `char* argv[]`, pointer vs array index arithmetic |
| `05-strings-and-buffer-safety` | Strings & Buffer Safety | Null terminator (`\0`), `snprintf`, safe string bounds, `strlen` vs `sizeof` |
| `06-structs-unions-and-alignment` | Struct Packing & Memory Alignment | Padding bytes, `__attribute__((packed))`, unions for type punning, bitfields |
| `07-bitwise-operations-and-masks` | Bitwise Manipulation & Flags | Bitwise operators (`&`, `|`, `^`, `~`, `<<`, `>>`), mask flags, bit clearing |
| `08-functions-and-function-pointers` | Function Pointers & Callbacks | Callback dispatch architectures, jump tables, event handlers |
| `09-preprocessor-and-macros` | Preprocessor Metaprogramming | `#define`, stringification (`#`), token pasting (`##`), header guards |
| `10-file-io-and-streams` | Standard File Streams | `fopen`, `fread`, `fwrite`, `fclose`, binary vs text mode, buffering |
| `11-posix-system-calls-and-file-descriptors` | POSIX Low-Level I/O | `open`, `read`, `write`, `close`, file descriptors (0, 1, 2), `lseek` |
| `12-processes-and-signals` | Processes & Signal Handlers | `fork()`, `execve()`, `waitpid()`, zombie processes, `sigaction` |
| `13-posix-threads-pthreads` | Multithreading with pthreads | `pthread_create`, `pthread_join`, `pthread_mutex_t`, race conditions |
| `14-dynamic-data-structures` | Dynamic Data Structures | Linked lists, growable dynamic vectors, hash tables in pure C |
| `15-shared-libraries-and-linking` | Dynamic Linking & dlsym | Static (`.a`) vs Shared (`.so`), `dlopen`, `dlsym`, symbol resolution |
| `16-debugging-with-gdb-and-valgrind` | Debugging & Memory Profiling | GDB stack backtraces, Valgrind Memcheck for invalid reads/writes |
| `17-safe-c-best-practices` | Defensive Systems Engineering | Integer overflow prevention, `goto cleanup` idiom, null validation |
| `18-interview-questions-and-drills` | Interview Mastery Drills | Top 10 C gotchas (Dangling pointers, sequence points, alignment faults) |

---

## 🛠️ How to Practice
Each module contains:
- `README.md` — Deep theoretical explanation and architecture notes.
- `example.c` — Fully runnable concept demonstration.
- `exercise/starter.c` — Hands-on problem with `TODO` markers.
- `exercise/solution.c` — Complete reference solution.
